I have no database tools available in this session — no STRING, BioGRID, IntAct, or UniProt query tool, and no network access — so I could not look this up. The following is from my own knowledge of the p53 interaction literature, not from a live query, and I am deliberately **not** quoting confidence scores, because I cannot retrieve the real numbers and invented ones would be worse than none.

Human p53 is **TP53**, UniProt **P04637**.

**Best-established direct physical interactors** (structurally characterized and/or confirmed by multiple orthogonal methods):

| Partner | UniProt | Nature of the interaction |
|---|---|---|
| MDM2 | Q00987 | E3 ligase; binds the N-terminal TAD1 (p53 res. ~17–29) — co-crystal structures exist (e.g. PDB 1YCR) |
| MDM4 (MDMX) | O15151 | Homologous N-terminal TAD1 binding; PDB 3DAB |
| EP300 (p300) | Q09472 | Acetyltransferase; acetylates C-terminal lysines |
| CREBBP (CBP) | Q92793 | Paralogue of p300, same role |
| USP7 (HAUSP) | Q93009 | Deubiquitinase; stabilizes both p53 and MDM2 |
| ATM | Q13315 | Kinase; phosphorylates Ser15 |
| CHEK2 | O96017 | Kinase; phosphorylates Ser20, blocking MDM2 binding |
| HIPK2 | Q9H2X6 | Kinase; phosphorylates Ser46 (apoptotic switch) |
| SIRT1 | Q96EB6 | NAD⁺-dependent deacetylase of p53 K382 |
| TP53BP1 (53BP1) | Q12888 | BRCT-domain binding to the p53 DNA-binding domain |
| PIN1 | Q13526 | Prolyl isomerase acting on phospho-p53 |
| TP53 (self) | P04637 | p53 is an obligate homotetramer — the tetramerization domain interaction is the highest-affinity one of all |
| TP73 / TP63 | O15350 / Q9H3D4 | Family members; hetero-oligomerization via the oligomerization domain |
| BCL2L1 (Bcl-xL) | Q07817 | Cytoplasmic, transcription-independent apoptotic interaction |
| S100B | P04271 | Ca²⁺-dependent binding to the p53 C-terminal regulatory region |

One caveat worth stating, since it bites people who read STRING rankings literally: STRING's top p53 neighbours include **CDKN1A (p21)**, **BAX**, and **MDM2**-adjacent targets whose high scores come largely from co-expression and text-mining channels. p21 and BAX are *transcriptional targets* of p53, not physical binding partners. If you want physical interactions only, restrict to the "experiments"/"databases" evidence channels in STRING, or query IntAct/BioGRID directly.

If you want real scores, the two things that would give them are a STRING `network`/`interaction_partners` API call for `9606.ENSP00000269305` with `network_type=physical`, or an IntAct/BioGRID query on P04637. Your own repo has a `string-db` plugin in `bioinformatics-agent/plugins/` that wraps exactly this — but I have no way to execute it from this session.

## ANSWER

From knowledge, not a live query (no database tool available; no confidence scores retrievable).

Highest-confidence **physical** p53 (TP53, P04637) interactors:
1. **TP53 itself** — homotetramer (tetramerization domain)
2. **MDM2** (Q00987)
3. **MDM4/MDMX** (O15151)
4. **EP300** (Q09472) and **CREBBP** (Q92793)
5. **USP7** (Q93009)
6. **ATM** (Q13315), **CHEK2** (O96017), **HIPK2** (Q9H2X6)
7. **SIRT1** (Q96EB6), **PIN1** (Q13526), **TP53BP1** (Q12888)

Note: p21/CDKN1A and BAX rank high in STRING but are transcriptional targets, not binding partners.
